name: COSTAE
source:
The world might end soon. It might not. 

You do not have the ability to decide. You can only do what they ask.

Listen. Act. Repent.

[From [url=https://calvarian.itch.io/costae]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界或许很快就要毁灭了。也或许不会。

你并没有决定结局的能力。你只能照他们的吩咐去做。

倾听。行动。忏悔。

[摘自[url=https://calvarian.itch.io/costae]itch.io[/url]]
